versions.changelog:
- Added detailed security and credential management guidelines, strictly prohibiting agents from accessing or displaying sensitive AK/SK information.
- Expanded documentation to cover 52 ModelArts API interfaces across 8 functional domains, with explicit CLI command patterns and pre-flight checks.
- Enforced step-by-step user instructions for credential configuration, shifting all AK/SK setup outside the agent session.
- Integrated mandatory user confirmation before any write operation, referencing common issues and workarounds from known-issues documentation.
- Updated workflow and recommended IAM practices to improve user experience and security.
